Name: Seed Sorter
Author: Acradius
Description:
Hello everyone, this is my first mod!  A big shout-out to the Stardew Valley Discord Modding channel for all their help!

This is a simple mod that adds a new craftable item to the game called a Seed Sorter.  It takes Mixed Seeds and sorts them into another type of seed found in the game.  Currently, only seeds from the base Stardew Valley game are possible outputs, but all crops sold in stores (and some that aren't!) are possible.  You can even get extremely rare items and seeds that don't appear in stores until your second year!  Fruit trees are not included.

While the list of possible seeds is limited, this mod should offer no compatibility problems with any other mods.

If you're looking for more functionality to Mixed Seeds, go check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better Mixed Seeds by epicbellyflop45[/url]﻿.  Unfortunately, my Seed Sorter mod won't provide the additional seed type possibilities that theirs does.  Even if you have both mods installed, or another mod that alters the possible outcomes of planting a Mixed Seed, you'll still only get the seeds from the vanilla game out of my Seed Sorter machine.

[size=3][b][u]Requirements
[/u][/b][/size]The latest versions of:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]

[size=3][b][u]Installation

[/u][/b][/size]Installation should be easy.  Once you have all the requirements installed, just unzip the file into your Mods folder.

Thanks for giving my mod a try!  I hope to create more in the future!
